source: golfisverige.com's card for Johannesberg's nine. VERIFIED ARITHMETICALLY before any geometry was fitted to it: the nine pars sum to the printed 34, and BOTH tee columns reproduce their printed Out totals exactly — Röd 261+234+208+94+240+284+134+350+104 = 1909, and Gul 302+270+248+126+271+319+161+399+163 = 2259. The stroke indexes are the odd numbers 1..17 with no repeats, which is what a nine-hole card rated over eighteen must carry.
note: Par 34 over nine holes (par 68 played as eighteen). A full-length Pay & Play nine by Donald Steel, the same architect as the eighteen — the club is 27 holes in total. Only two tees are published (Gul, Röd). The holes are NOT in OpenStreetMap: the club's whole extract carries two greens and no fairways, tees or bunkers at all, so this nine has to be traced from orthoimagery exactly as the eighteen was. On the ground it lies WEST and NORTH-WEST of the manor, between the manor buildings and the farmland, with its own small ponds.
